s1.syndrome_frame: A patient with a history of type 2 diabetes and hypertension presents with symptoms of fatigue, light-headedness, and dyspnea on exertion, and has abnormal heart rhythm and conduction
salient_findings: Abnormal heart rate of 47 beats per minute
Some P waves do not conduct to ventricles
key_facts: Patient is in their 70s
Patient has a medical history of type 2 diabetes
Patient has a medical history of hypertension
Patient presented with fatigue
Patient presented with light-headedness
Patient presented with dyspnea on exertion
Patient has a heart rate of 47 beats per minute
Patient has a blood pressure of 148/59 mm Hg
Patient has a prolonged PR interval
Patient has some P waves that do not conduct to ventricles
Patient has a right bundle-branch block
Echocardiogram showed normal biventricular function
Echocardiogram showed no significant valvular lesions

shortlist.label: Mobitz Type II Atrioventricular Block
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a prolonged PR interval and some P waves do not conduct to ventricles

shortlist.label: Sick Sinus Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of fatigue, light-headedness, and dyspnea on exertion, and has abnormal heart rhythm

shortlist.label: His-Purkinje Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a prolonged His-ventricular interval and a right bundle-branch block

shortlist.label: Lev-Lenegre Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a prolonged PR interval and a right bundle-branch block, consistent with a progressive cardiac conduction defect

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG findings show a prolonged PR interval, some P waves that do not conduct to ventricles, and a right bundle-branch block, which are characteristic of Mobitz Type II Atrioventricular Block.

rejected.label: Sick Sinus Syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's ECG shows a normal sinus rhythm, which is not consistent with Sick Sinus Syndrome.

rejected.label: His-Purkinje Disease
rejected.why: While the patient has a prolonged His-ventricular interval, this finding alone is not sufficient to diagnose His-Purkinje Disease without other supporting evidence.

rejected.label: Lev-Lenegre Syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's age and ECG findings are not typical of Lev-Lenegre Syndrome, which is a rare condition characterized by a prolonged PR interval and widening of the QRS complex.

rejected.label: Complete Heart Block
rejected.why: The patient's ECG shows that some P waves do conduct to ventricles, indicating that it is not a complete heart block.
